title: Arbutin Reshapes Intestinal Microbiota to Ameliorate Lipid Metabolic Dysfunction and Inflammation.
publicationName: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
journalName: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
snippet: Gut microbial dysbiosis drives obesity-related metabolic disorders. This study investigated whether arbutin, a phenolic glycoside, alleviates obesity via gut microbiota modulation.
